# Color balance (lift, gamma, gain)

The three wheels of a grading tool: lift tints the shadows, gamma the midtones and gain the highlights, per channel.

<EffectDemo effect="color-balance" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { colorBalance } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/color-balance';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(colorBalance({ preset: 'tealOrange' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.lift = [0, 0, 0]`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter           | Type      | Default     | Range      | Description                                                       |
| ------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lift`              | [x, y, z] | `[0, 0, 0]` | -0.5 – 0.5 | Added to the shadows, fading out toward white (red, green, blue). |
| `gamma`             | [x, y, z] | `[1, 1, 1]` | 0.3 – 3    | Midtone gamma per channel; above 1 brightens.                     |
| `gain`              | [x, y, z] | `[1, 1, 1]` | 0 – 2      | Multiplies the highlights per channel.                            |
| `preserveLuminance` | boolean   | `false`     |            | Keep each pixel’s brightness, so the wheels only shift color.     |
| `amount`            | number    | `1`         | 0 – 1      | Mix between the original and the graded image.                    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset           | Settings                                                                         |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tealOrange`     | `lift: [-0.02, 0.02, 0.05]`, `gain: [1.08, 1, 0.9]`, `preserveLuminance: true`   |
| `warmHighlights` | `gain: [1.1, 1.03, 0.92]`                                                        |
| `coolShadows`    | `lift: [-0.03, 0.01, 0.06]`                                                      |
| `filmic`         | `lift: [0.03, 0.03, 0.04]`, `gamma: [0.95, 0.97, 1]`, `gain: [0.97, 0.97, 0.95]` |

Apply one with `colorBalance({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.12 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/color-balance`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Split toning](./split-toning) — Tints the shadows with one color and the highlights with another, keeping brightness, like a darkroom split tone or a modern teal-and-orange grade.
- [Curves](./curves) — Tone curves like a photo editor’s: a master curve for contrast and one curve per channel for color, through smooth points that never overshoot.
- [White balance](./white-balance) — Camera-style white balance: tell it the color temperature of the light and it neutralizes it (a Bradford adaptation in linear light), with a green–magenta tint.
